sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Atonic dyspepsia, with gas and acidity.
Heartburn and gastralgia. Regurgitation of food. Ab-
domen feels empty and retracted.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Excessive desire — impossible to retain
urine ; copious micturition day and night. As soon as
the child wakes up the bed is drenched.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Inclination to yawn and stretch.
[AVim.?.] Sensation of coldness over back. Prostration,
with hunger. Cold extremities, with sensation of in-
ternal coldness. [Heloderma,]

sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Awoke with great anxiety and solicitude, without cause, at 1
a.m. ; was unable to sleep; felt wide awake, with manifold thoughts in his
brain ; on attempting to read, could only stare at the book on account of
anxious thoughts running through his mind ; about 3 o’clock he rose and
dressed, and attempted to write, but was so absent-minded that he could
not find words to express himself; the next day he was unable to perform
any mental labor, not on account of disinclination to work, but from ab¬
sence of thought, 2 .—An anxious mood returned on going to sleep, but dis¬
appeared in the night (third day), 2 .

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
(A peculiar sensation in the head, as if the senses would van¬
ish, followed by excessive weakness, great heat, copious hot perspiration,
with great hunger, followed by coldness of the extremities, with a sensation
of internal coldness; the whole attack lasted about two hours; when it
was not possible to satisfy the hunger, the weakness increased, copious per¬
spiration broke out over the whole body, followed after a long time by
gradual relief), 3 .f—Constant dulness of the head (second day), 2 .—(Pain and
heaviness in the forehead, with at times dulness of the head), 3 .—(Slight
drawing in the left side of the head and face), 3 .

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Great inclination to qualmishness, 1 .—Drawing pain in the
stomach, accompanied by a sensation as if the stomach were full of hot
water, 2 .

Abdomen •—Slight drawing pains in both hypochondria, with a sen¬
sation as if the abdomen were empty and retracted to the spinal column;
pain somewhat aggravated by deep breathing; these symptoms recurred
three times during the day, lasted from twenty to thirty minutes, and were
accompanied by a sensation as though he would have a stool (first day), 2 .
—[10.] Very acute sticking in the hepatic region ; the acute pain lasted
only the first day, but for several days the pain was dull, and only disap¬
peared after twelve days, 1 .—Abdomen hard and distended (second day), 2 .
—Sticking pains in the abdomen, between the umbilicus and stomach,
frequently recurring and lasting several days (soon), 1 .—A peculiar beating
through the abdomen, extending into the extremities, with general nervous
troubles (second day), 1 .

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Stools at first hard, with great effort, afterwards pasty, once
very thin, 2 .

Urinary Organs. —Secretion of urine increased, solid constituents
diminished; sp. gr., in the morning, 1007 and 1009; during the day 1001
and 1004, 2 .

Respiratory Organs. —(Hoarseness, perhaps to be ascribed to a
change in the weather), 1 .

sections.label: Neck
sections.text:
Slight drawing pains in the cervical muscles (after 3 grains), 3 .

Inferior Extremities. —Drawing pain in the calves (half an hour
after 1 grain), 3 .

Generalities. —General discomfort (second day), 2 .

Fever «—[20.] Seusation of coldness running over the back, with con¬
stant inclination to yawn and desire to stretch out the feet, 2 .

| This symptom is only noted, and cannot be directly ascribed to the action of
Quassia, as I had previously suffered from similar attacks.

256

RANUNCULUS ACRIS.

RANUNCULUS ACRIS.

Ranunculus acris, Linn.

Natural order, Ranunculaceje.

Preparation, Tincture of the whole plant.

Authorities. 1, Krebs, Frank’s Mag., 3, 312, Heidelb. Annals, 1835, a
woman, seventy years old, applied a handful of the herb to her limbs; 2,
Franz, Archiv. f. Horn., 7, 3, 218; 3, Lembke, N. Zeit. f. Horn. Klin., 12,
26, took an infusion of the herb twice first and second days, three times
third day; 3a, same, proving repeated, doses on first, second, fourth, and
sixth days.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Headache, 2 . — Tearing in the forehead, in the face (third
day), 3 .

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Red face, 1 .—Violent tearing in the right cheek, towards the
temples, in the evening (first day), 3a .

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
A continuous scraping taste in the throat (shortly after first
dose); this sensation lasted longer when larger doses were taken, 3 .

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Frequent eructations of tasteless flatus (after second dose,
second day), 31 .—Some nausea (after second dose, second day); nausea, with
much saliva in the mouth (after third dose, second day) ; slight nausea
(fourth day), 3 *.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
5 p.m., copious fluid stool without pain, and again at 7 p.m.
(first day), 3 *.—[10.] Two loose stools, in the morning (third day), 3 .

Urinary Organs. —During the night frequent micturition (fourth
night); this had not occurred during the previous nights, although no
change had been made in my mode of living; no micturition (fifth night), 3 .
—In the night micturated three times; urine normal (second night), 31 .

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Tearing in the muscles on the right side of the cbest, below
the nipple, increased during inspiration (after second dose, second day) ;
similar pain in right side of chest (third day), 31 .

False. —Small rapid pulse, 1 .

Hack. —* Pain several times in the lumbar muscles, in bending and turn¬
ing the body, and in the joints already mentioned (fourth day); the same
pains were felt in the morning, and several times during the day, whether
in sitting or in motion (fifth day), 31 .

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Soreness of the joints, 2 .—Boring and drawing pains
in the right tibia and in the elbow (after second dose, second day), 31 .—
Violent pressing pains in the joints of the elbow, ankle, and knee when
sitting; motion appeared to relieve them (after third dose, second day)/ 1 .
—Tearing in the wrist and ankle-joints, in the thumb, in walking and
resting (first day), 31 .—[20.] Tearing in the joints of the wrist, ankle, and
shoulder, in the forehead, and in the muscles of the right side of the chest
(sixth day), 31 .—Tearing in the hip, shoulder, and ankle-joints (fourth day), 31 .
■—Wandering pains in the limbs, in the joints of the hands, knees, feet, and
toes (second and third days), 3 .

Inferior Extremities. —Several times, on walking, felt a heavi¬
ness and weakness in the legs (third day) ; also when in bed, in the morn¬
ing (fourth day), 3 .—Tearing in the front of the tibise and in the temples
(third day), 31 .—Drawing pains in the ankle-joints (after second dose, second
day), 31 .—Tearing in the left ankle-joint (after first dose, second day), 31 .—
